decision: Rejected: ordered fast path benefits sorted inputs but adds a late-inversion scan and showed tiled API regressions. Production sorting is unchanged.

sameImplementation.scope: Synchronous WASM sort API including validation, JS/WASM copies and result allocation. Separate warmed WASM instances; excludes input generation, JS reference sort, verification, projection, upload and GPU. Not a memory or frame-time benchmark.
